feedback: The test cases for requirement R006 correctly exercise the left-to-right evaluation of operators of equal precedence. Test R006-T01 ('3 - 5 - 2') validates subtraction evaluated left-to-right, yielding -4, as required. Test R006-T02 ('10 - 3 * 2 + 1') correctly demonstrates that despite multiplication having higher precedence, subtraction and addition are evaluated left-to-right, resulting in 5, not 7. The mathematical reference checks confirm the expected outputs are accurate. The tests cover the core intent of the requirement and are well-motivated with clear justifications. No revisions are needed.
